name: Conjurer's Countermeasure

duration.value: until the end of your next turn

text:
You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft. You gain resistance 5 against damage from spells.

The resistance from this spell is cumulative with that of Arcane Cascade. If you're in Arcane Cascade stance when the duration of conjurer's countermeasure expires, the spell's duration extends until Arcane Cascade ends.

---
Heightened (+3) The resistance increases by 5.

Spell Effect: Conjurer's Countermeasure
